messages.subject: Campus Drive: Zentrix Analytics – Data Analyst (2026 batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Zentrix Analytics is visiting campus for the Data Analyst role (CTC 9.5 LPA).
Eligibility: B.Tech CSE, IT, ECE | CGPA 7.0 and above | No active backlogs.
Register here: https://forms.gle/demoZentrix by 11:59 PM, 12 September 2026.

Regards,
Career Office

messages.subject: Re: Campus Drive: Zentrix Analytics – Data Analyst (2026 batch)
messages.body: Correction: As per the company's update, ECE students are NOT eligible for this drive. Eligible branches: CSE and IT only. Deadline unchanged.
